headline: Lead Release Engineer | GitHub Actions | CI/CD
summary_html: Release Engineer with 10+ years of experience in CI/CD automation, release coordination, source control governance, and production delivery. Builds reusable GitHub Actions and Jenkins workflows, governs Git branching and artifact promotion, and coordinates environment readiness, deployment dependencies, validation, and rollback planning. Experienced with ServiceNow change requests, CAB approval coordination, and ITIL processes. Hands-on with MuleSoft, Flosum, and Copado for integration and Salesforce release tooling; MuleSoft Certified Developer with a foundation in API integration and Maven-based delivery.

skill_sections.title: Release Management
skill_sections.content: Release calendars, readiness reviews, deployment sequencing, go/no-go inputs, rollback plans, release notes, production validation, cross-team dependency coordination

skill_sections.title: GitHub and CI/CD
skill_sections.content: GitHub Actions, Git, pull requests, protected branches, release and hotfix branches, trunk-based workflows, Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, Azure DevOps, YAML

skill_sections.title: Salesforce and Integration Tooling
skill_sections.content: MuleSoft, Flosum, Copado, Maven, REST APIs, API and database release dependencies, JFrog Artifactory, Nexus; MuleSoft Certified Developer

skill_sections.title: Environments and Automation
skill_sections.content: Environment-specific variables, secrets access, configuration validation, self-hosted runners, Linux, Python, Bash, PowerShell, Ansible, Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, Helm

skill_sections.title: Quality and Change Governance
skill_sections.content: Automated tests, SonarQube, JFrog Xray, security scanning, ServiceNow change requests, CAB approvals, ITIL processes, release evidence, deployment runbooks

skill_sections.title: Pipeline Health and Enablement
skill_sections.content: Pipeline dashboards, deployment monitoring, failure analysis, defect tracking, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, release retrospectives, Git mentoring, technical documentation

experience.title: Lead Release Engineer
impact: Coordinated release schedules, scope, dependencies, and readiness with Development, QA, Infrastructure, Security, and business stakeholders.
Maintained release calendars and communicated blockers, approval status, deployment progress, and production readiness across engineering teams.
Prepared go/no-go inputs covering test evidence, environment prerequisites, change risk, deployment ownership, and rollback criteria.
Built reusable CI/CD workflows for build, testing, packaging, environment promotion, and post-deployment verification.
Governed Git feature, release, hotfix, and trunk-based workflows with protected branches, merge approvals, and source-control access policies.
Authored deployment runbooks, release notes, implementation sequences, and recovery guidance for controlled production changes.
Automated release preparation, configuration checks, and deployment validation with Python, PowerShell, and Bash.
Validated environment variables, secrets access, artifact versions, infrastructure prerequisites, and application dependencies before promotion.
Coordinated smoke tests and post-release monitoring; resolved deployment conflicts and production issues with application and infrastructure owners.
Monitored pipeline duration, failure trends, runner capacity, and deployment health to identify automation and reliability improvements.
Mentored engineers on branching, merge standards, pipeline troubleshooting, and documented release procedures.

Maintained environment-specific variables and release configuration to keep deployment inputs consistent across stages.
Organized artifact feeds and package versions, ensuring teams promoted the intended release package and dependencies.
Applied branch protection, merge controls, and image-validation checks before application deployment.
Coordinated readiness checks and test evidence with QA and developers before environment promotion.
Troubleshot pipeline, container, and Kubernetes deployment failures and verified corrective actions with service owners.
Documented release procedures, known issues, and operational handoffs to support repeatable delivery.

experience.title: Senior Release Engineer II

Investigated deployment failures using pipeline logs and platform telemetry; coordinated recovery and post-deployment validation.
Created release documentation and recovery guidance, incorporating monitoring and backup controls into operational readiness.
